title: Same PO and amount as a paid invoice, with OVERLAPPING service periods
rationale_key_facts: Vendor matches HL-3301 after suffix normalisation (Ltd and Limited).
Same PO-4422, gross identical at $4,300.00, and the dates are 19 days apart, inside the 45-day window.
The service periods are 1-28 February and 15 February to 14 March. They overlap across 15-28 February.
Clause 8.1 rescues only distinct, NON-overlapping periods, so it does not apply and every condition of clause 8 is met.
SERVICES PO, so the absent goods receipt is normal and not a defect.
